version_relation: Independent v3 stat-reference table. Does not mutate or override v1/v2 mechanic bindings.

source_notes.database: Directly inspected 14 Once Human Database weapon pages. Each warns that client records have different stat values and their in-game tier/calibration labels are unconfirmed. No unique mechanic tooltip appears on those pages.
source_notes.historical: Held catalog imported from a pinned March 2026 community weapon_list.json snapshot. Numeric rows have no confirmed tier, stars, or calibration and may differ from later database pages. The raw range field has unspecified units and is not equated to full-damage range or range score.
source_notes.damage_basis: Displayed weapon Damage and historical damage_per_projectile are reference fields, not measured character Attack or Psi Intensity. Damage class and status/event multipliers must come from separate evidence.
source_notes.reload: Reload score/points and displayed seconds are separate fields. Do not convert score to seconds. Actual reload duration depends on selected weapon and bonuses; official Reload Efficiency formula applies to a known base time.
